changeSet.author: researchspace
changeSet.comment: Materialize each open weekday's effective interval, including revision history, before retiring application writes to shared hours.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE BookingConfiguration current JOIN ( SELECT old.id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'dayOfWeek', days.dayOfWeek, 'start', COALESCE(exception.startTime, old.openingStart), 'end', COALESCE(exception.endTime, old.openingEnd)) ORDER BY days.dayOfWeek) AS hours FROM BookingConfiguration old JOIN (SELECT 1 AS dayOfWeek UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7) days ON (JSON_CONTAINS(old.openDays, CAST(days.dayOfWeek AS CHAR))) LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(old.openingExceptions, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( dayOfWeek INT PATH '$.dayOfWeek', startTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.start', endTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.end')) exception ON exception.dayOfWeek = days.dayOfWeek WHERE old.openingStart IS NOT NULL AND old.openingEnd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY old.id ) migrated ON migrated.id = current.id SET current.openingHours = migrated.hours; UPDATE BookingConfigurationDefaults current JOIN ( SELECT old.id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'dayOfWeek', days.dayOfWeek, 'start', COALESCE(exception.startTime, old.openingStart), 'end', COALESCE(exception.endTime, old.openingEnd)) ORDER BY days.dayOfWeek) AS hours FROM BookingConfigurationDefaults old JOIN (SELECT 1 AS dayOfWeek UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7) days ON (JSON_CONTAINS(old.openDays, CAST(days.dayOfWeek AS CHAR))) LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(old.openingExceptions, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( dayOfWeek INT PATH '$.dayOfWeek', startTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.start', endTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.end')) exception ON exception.dayOfWeek = days.dayOfWeek WHERE old.openingStart IS NOT NULL AND old.openingEnd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY old.id ) migrated ON migrated.id = current.id SET current.openingHours = migrated.hours; UPDATE BookingConfiguration_AUD current JOIN ( SELECT old.id, old.REV, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'dayOfWeek', days.dayOfWeek, 'start', COALESCE(exception.startTime, old.openingStart), 'end', COALESCE(exception.endTime, old.openingEnd)) ORDER BY days.dayOfWeek) AS hours FROM BookingConfiguration_AUD old JOIN (SELECT 1 AS dayOfWeek UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7) days ON (JSON_CONTAINS(old.openDays, CAST(days.dayOfWeek AS CHAR)) OR old.openDays IS NULL) LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(old.openingExceptions, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( dayOfWeek INT PATH '$.dayOfWeek', startTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.start', endTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.end')) exception ON exception.dayOfWeek = days.dayOfWeek WHERE old.openingStart IS NOT NULL AND old.openingEnd IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(old.REVTYPE, 0) <> 2 GROUP BY old.id, old.REV ) migrated ON migrated.id = current.id AND migrated.REV = current.REV SET current.openingHours = migrated.hours; UPDATE BookingConfigurationDefaults_AUD current JOIN ( SELECT old.id, old.REV, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'dayOfWeek', days.dayOfWeek, 'start', COALESCE(exception.startTime, old.openingStart), 'end', COALESCE(exception.endTime, old.openingEnd)) ORDER BY days.dayOfWeek) AS hours FROM BookingConfigurationDefaults_AUD old JOIN (SELECT 1 AS dayOfWeek UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7) days ON (JSON_CONTAINS(old.openDays, CAST(days.dayOfWeek AS CHAR)) OR old.openDays IS NULL) LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(COALESCE(old.openingExceptions, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS ( dayOfWeek INT PATH '$.dayOfWeek', startTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.start', endTime VARCHAR(5) PATH '$.end')) exception ON exception.dayOfWeek = days.dayOfWeek WHERE old.openingStart IS NOT NULL AND old.openingEnd IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(old.REVTYPE, 0) <> 2 GROUP BY old.id, old.REV ) migrated ON migrated.id = current.id AND migrated.REV = current.REV SET current.openingHours = migrated.hours;
